qEn: Which of the following is a Kharif crop grown in India?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी भारत में उगाई जाने वाली खरीफ फसल है?
explainEn: Paddy (rice) requires high water and temperature, making it a typical Kharif crop sown with the onset of monsoon.

qEn: What is the chemical formula of bleaching powder?
qHi: विरंजक चूर्ण (ब्लीचिंग पाउडर) का रासायनिक सूत्र क्या है?
explainEn: Bleaching powder is represented chemically as calcium oxychloride, CaOCl2.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 10 Science Chapter 2 - Acids, Bases and Salts

qEn: In which state is the Corbett National Park located?
qHi: कॉर्बेट राष्ट्रीय उद्यान किस राज्य में स्थित है?
explainEn: Jim Corbett National Park is located in the Nainital district of Uttarakhand and was India's first national park.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 10 Geography Chapter 2 - Forest and Wildlife Resources

qEn: What is the SI unit of electric current?
qHi: विद्युत धारा का एसआई (SI) मात्रक क्या है?
explainEn: The SI unit of electric current is the Ampere, named after the French physicist André-Marie Ampère.

qEn: Which type of mirror is commonly used as a rear-view mirror in vehicles?
qHi: वाहनों में पीछे देखने के लिए सामान्यतः किस प्रकार के दर्पण का उपयोग किया जाता है?
explainEn: Convex mirrors are used as rear-view mirrors because they give an erect, diminished image and provide a wider field of view.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 10 Science Chapter 10 - Light: Reflection and Refraction

qEn: Which level of government in India has the power to legislate on subjects included in the Union List?
qHi: भारत में किस स्तर की सरकार को संघ सूची में शामिल विषयों पर कानून बनाने की शक्ति प्राप्त है?
explainEn: Subjects of national importance like defense, foreign affairs, and banking are in the Union List, on which only the Union Parliament makes laws.

qEn: Which of the following is a primary economic sector activity?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी प्राथमिक क्षेत्र की आर्थिक गतिविधि है?
explainEn: Agriculture, forestry, and fishing form part of the primary sector as they involve extracting or harvesting natural products.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 10 Economics Chapter 2 - Sectors of the Indian Economy

qEn: Which gas is liberated when an acid reacts with a metal?
qHi: अम्ल की धातु के साथ अभिक्रिया होने पर कौन सी गैस निकलती है?
explainEn: When acids react with reactive metals, they generally release hydrogen gas along with a salt.

qEn: Which part of the plant is responsible for the transport of water?
qHi: पौधे का कौन सा भाग जल के परिवहन के लिए उत्तरदायी है?
explainEn: Xylem tissue in plants is responsible for the transport of water and dissolved minerals from roots to leaves.

qEn: In which state of India is the Corbett National Park located?
qHi: कार्बेट राष्ट्रीय उद्यान भारत के किस राज्य में स्थित है?
explainEn: Jim Corbett National Park is situated in the Nainital district of Uttarakhand and was established in 1936.

qEn: Which of the following is a renewable source of energy?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा ऊर्जा का नवीकरणीय स्रोत है?
explainEn: Solar energy is inexhaustible and naturally replenishes itself, making it a renewable source of energy.

qEn: Who wrote the novel 'Hind Swaraj' in 1909?
qHi: वर्ष 1909 में 'हिंद स्वराज' उपन्यास किसने लिखा था?
explainEn: 'Hind Swaraj' was written by Mahatma Gandhi in 1909, outlining his views on Swaraj and modern civilization.

qEn: What type of chemical reaction is represented by the digestion of food in the body?
qHi: शरीर में भोजन का पचon किस प्रकार की रासायनिक अभिक्रिया को दर्शाता है?
explainEn: The digestion of food involves complex food substances breaking down into simpler substances, which is a decomposition reaction.

qEn: Which mineral is mined in the Kudremukh mines of Karnataka?
qHi: कर्नाटक की कुद्रेमुख खदानों में कौन सा खनिज निकाला जाता है?
explainEn: Kudremukh in Karnataka is known for large deposits of high-grade iron ore.

qEn: Which mirror is commonly used as a rear-view mirror in vehicles because it gives an erect and diminished image?
qHi: वाहनों में पीछे देखने के लिए सामान्यतः किस दर्पण का उपयोग किया जाता है क्योंकि यह सीधा और छोटा प्रतिबिंब देता है?
explainEn: Convex mirrors are used as rear-view mirrors because they always give an erect, virtual image and have a wider field of view.

qEn: What is the process of conversion of solid directly into gas without changing into liquid state called?
qHi: ठोस वस्तु का बिना द्रव अवस्था में बदले सीधे गैस में परिवर्तन होने की प्रक्रिया क्या कहलाती है?
explainEn: Sublimation is the transition of a substance directly from the solid to the gas state, bypassing the liquid state.

qEn: Which plant hormone is primarily responsible for cell division and is abundantly found in areas of rapid cell division such as fruits and seeds?
qHi: कौन सा पादप हॉर्मोन मुख्य रूप से कोशिका विभाजन के लिए उत्तरदायी है और तेजी से कोशिका विभाजन वाले क्षेत्रों जैसे फलों और बीजों में प्रचुर मात्रा में पाया जाता है?
explainEn: Cytokinins are plant hormones that promote cell division and are present in high concentrations in growing tissues.

qEn: In which part of the Indian Constitution are the Fundamental Rights enshrined?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान के किस भाग में मौलिक अधिकार निहित हैं?
explainEn: Fundamental Rights are guaranteed under Part III (Articles 12 to 35) of the Constitution of India.

qEn: Which soil type is most suitable for the growth of cotton and is also known as regur soil?
qHi: कपास की खेती के लिए कौन सी मिट्टी सबसे उपयुक्त है और इसे रेगुर मिट्टी भी कहा जाता है?
explainEn: Black soil is ideal for growing cotton and is also known as black cotton soil or regur soil.

qEn: What is the commercial unit of electrical energy consumed in households?
qHi: घरों में खपत होने वाली विद्युत ऊर्जा की व्यावसायिक इकाई क्या है?
explainEn: The commercial unit of electric energy is kilowatt-hour (kWh), commonly known as a 'unit'.

qEn: Which economic sector is also known as the service sector?
qHi: किस आर्थिक क्षेत्र को सेवा क्षेत्र के रूप में भी जाना जाता है?
explainEn: The tertiary sector generates services rather than goods and is therefore known as the service sector.

qEn: Which chemical compound is commonly known as washing soda?
qHi: किस रासायनिक यौगिक को सामान्यतः धोने का सोडा (वाशिंग सोडा) कहा जाता है?
explainEn: Washing soda is sodium carbonate decahydrate with the chemical formula Na2CO3.10H2O.

qEn: Which mirror is commonly used as a rear-view mirror in vehicles?
qHi: वाሽनों में पीछे देखने के लिए सामान्यतः किस दर्पण का उपयोग किया जाता है?
explainEn: Convex mirrors are used as rear-view mirrors because they give an erect, diminished image and have a wider field of view.

qEn: What is the chemical formula of washing soda?
qHi: धोने के सोडे का रासायनिक सूत्र क्या है?
explainEn: Washing soda is sodium carbonate decahydrate, represented by the formula Na2CO3.10H2O.

qEn: Which plant hormone is responsible for cell division?
qHi: कौन सा पादप हार्मोन कोशिका विभाजन के लिए उत्तरदायी है?
explainEn: Cytokinins are plant hormones that promote cell division, especially in plant roots and shoots.

qEn: In which part of the human digestive system is water primarily absorbed?
qHi: मानव पाचन तंत्र के किस भाग में मुख्य रूप से जल का अवशोषण होता है?
explainEn: The large intestine is primarily responsible for absorbing water from the remaining indigestible food matter.

qEn: Which of the following is a non-renewable source of energy?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा ऊर्जा का अनवीकरणीय स्रोत है?
explainEn: Coal is a fossil fuel and a non-renewable source of energy because it takes millions of years to form.

qEn: Which element is oxidized in the reaction represented by the equation: ZnO + C -> Zn + CO?
qHi: समीकरण ZnO + C -> Zn + CO द्वारा दर्शाई गई अभिक्रिया में किस तत्व का उपचयन होता है?
explainEn: Carbon (C) gains oxygen to form carbon monoxide (CO), so it undergoes oxidation.

qEn: What is the pH range of a neutral aqueous solution at 298 K?
qHi: 298 K पर एक उदासीन जलीय विलयन का pH परास क्या होता है?
explainEn: At standard temperature, a neutral solution has a pH value of exactly 7.

qEn: Which plant hormone is primarily responsible for the cell elongation and bending of shoots towards light?
qHi: कौन सा पादप हार्मोन मुख्य रूप से कोशिका दीर्घीकरण और प्ररोह के प्रकाश की ओर मुड़ने के लिए उत्तरदायी है?
explainEn: Auxin promotes cell growth and accumulates on the shaded side of the plant, causing phototropism.

qEn: What is the focal length of a plane mirror?
qHi: समतल दर्पण की फोकस दूरी क्या होती है?
explainEn: A plane mirror can be considered as a spherical mirror of infinite radius, making its focal length infinity.

qEn: Which sector is the largest employer in India according to economic studies?
qHi: आर्थिक अध्ययनों के अनुसार भारत में कौन सा क्षेत्र सबसे बड़ा नियोक्ता है?
explainEn: The primary sector, mainly agriculture, employs the largest share of the workforce in India.

qEn: Which soil type is most suitable for the growth of cotton in India?
qHi: भारत में कपास की वृद्धि के लिए कौन सी मिट्टी सबसे उपयुक्त है?
explainEn: Black soil, also known as regur soil, is ideal for growing cotton and is found extensively in the Deccan trap.

qEn: Which subject is included in the Union List of the Indian Constitution?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान की संघ सूची में कौन सा विषय शामिल है?
explainEn: Defence of the country is a matter of national importance and is listed in the Union List.

qEn: What was the main reason for the suspension of the Non-Cooperation Movement by Mahatma Gandhi in 1922?
qHi: 1922 में महात्मा गांधी द्वारा असहयोग आंदोलन को स्थगित करने का मुख्य कारण क्या था?
optsHi: चौरी चौरा की हिंसा की घटना
explainEn: Mahatma Gandhi withdrew the movement after a violent clash at the Chauri Chaura police station in Gorakhpur.

qEn: What is the process of plant leaves losing water in the form of water vapour called?
qHi: पौधे की पत्तियों द्वारा जल वाष्प के रूप में जल की हानि की प्रक्रिया क्या कहलाती है?
explainEn: Transpiration is the loss of water from the aerial parts of plants in the form of water vapour.

qEn: Which part of the human eye controls the amount of light entering it?
qHi: मानव आँख का कौन सा भाग उसमें प्रवेश करने वाले प्रकाश की मात्रा को नियंत्रित करता है?
explainEn: The iris is a dark muscular diaphragm that controls the size of the pupil and thus the amount of light entering the eye.

qEn: Which mineral is primarily mined in the Kudremukh mines of Karnataka?
qHi: कर्नाटक की कुद्रेमुख खानों में मुख्य रूप से किस खनिज का खनन किया जाता है?
explainEn: Kudremukh is a known reserve of iron ore in Karnataka.

qEn: What form of government does India have, as stated in its Constitution?
qHi: भारत के संविधान के अनुसार भारत में शासन का कौन सा रूप है?
explainEn: India has a parliamentary system of democratic government.

qEn: Which sector is also known as the service sector?
qHi: किस क्षेत्रक को सेवा क्षेत्रक के नाम से भी जाना जाता है?
explainEn: Activities that help in the development of primary and secondary sectors generate services instead of goods, hence called the tertiary or service sector.

qEn: Which mirror is commonly used as a rear-view mirror in vehicles because it gives an erect and diminished image of distant traffic?
qHi: वाਹਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਿੱਛੇ ਦਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ ਦੇਖਣ ਲਈ ਆਮ ਤੌਰ 'ਤੇ ਕਿਸ ਦਰਪਣ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਇਹ ਦੂਰ ਦੇ ਟ੍ਰੈਫਿਕ ਦਾ ਸਿੱਧਾ ਅਤੇ ਛੋਟਾ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਬਿੰਬ ਦਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ?
explainEn: Convex mirrors are used as rear-view mirrors because they always give an erect, diminished image and have a wider field of view.

qEn: Which plant hormone is primarily responsible for cell division and promotes rapid cell growth in areas such as fruits and seeds?
qHi: ਕਿਹੜਾ ਪੌਦਾ ਹਾਰਮੋਨ ਮੁੱਖ ਤੌਰ 'ਤੇ ਸੈੱਲ ਵਿਭਾਜਨ ਲਈ ਜ਼ਿੰਮੇवार ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਫਲਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਬੀਜਾਂ ਵਰਗੇ ਖੇਤਰਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਤੇਜ਼ ਸੈੱਲ ਵਾਧੇ ਨੂੰ ਉਤਸ਼ਾਹਿਤ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ?
explainEn: Cytokinins are hormones that promote cell division (cytokinesis) and are present in high concentrations in areas of rapid cell division, such as fruits and seeds.

qEn: What happens when dilute hydrochloric acid is added to iron fillings?
qHi: ਜਦੋਂ ਲੋਹੇ ਦੇ ਕਿੱਲਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਤਲਾ ਹਾਈਡ੍ਰੋਕ্লোਰਿਕ ਐਸਿਡ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਕੀ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ?
optsEn: Hydrogen gas and iron chloride are produced
Chlorine gas and iron hydroxide are produced
Iron salt and water are produced
optsHi: ਹਾਈਡ੍ਰੋਜਨ ਗੈਸ ਅਤੇ ਆਇਰਨ ਕਲੋਰਾਈਡ ਬਣਦੇ ਹਨ
ਕਲੋਰੀਨ ਗੈਸ ਅਤੇ ਆਇਰਨ ਹਾਈਡ੍ਰੋਆਕਸਾਈਡ ਬਣਦੇ ਹਨ
ਆਇਰਨ ਲੂਣ ਅਤੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਬਣਦੇ ਹਨ
explainEn: When an acid reacts with a metal, it produces a metal salt and hydrogen gas. Iron reacts with dilute HCl to form iron(II) chloride and hydrogen gas.

qEn: Which of the following is a primary consumer in a forest ecosystem?
qHi: ਹੇਠ ਲਿਖਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਜੰਗਲੀ ਵਾਤਾਵਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਣਾਲੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਪ੍ਰਾਇਮਰੀ ਖਪਤਕਾਰ ਕੌਣ ਹੈ?
explainEn: Primary consumers are herbivores that feed directly on producers (plants). Deer feed on plants, making them primary consumers.

qEn: Which state in India is the leading producer of manganese ore?
qHi: ਭਾਰਤ ਦਾ ਕਿਹੜਾ ਰਾਜ ਮੈਂਗਨੀਜ਼ ਕੱਚੀ ਧਾਕ ਦਾ ਮੋਹਰੀ ਉਤਪਾਦਕ ਹੈ?
explainEn: Odisha is the leading producer of manganese ore in India, accounting for a major share of the total production.

qEn: In which type of power plant is water heated using the heat originating from deep within the Earth's crust?
qHi: ਧਰਤੀ ਦੇ ਛਿਲਕੇ ਦੇ ਅੰਦਰੋਂ ਨਿਕਲਣ ਵਾਲੀ ਗਰਮੀ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕਰਕੇ ਕਿਸ ਕਿਸਮ ਦੇ ਪਾਵਰ ਪਲਾਂਟ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਾਣੀ ਨੂੰ ਗਰਮ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ?
explainEn: Geothermal energy utilizes heat from within the Earth's crust to heat water and generate steam for electricity generation.

qEn: Which tier of government in India was added by the 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act?
qHi: 73ਵੇਂ ਸੰਵਿਧਾਨਕ ਸੋਧ ਐਕਟ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਭਾਰਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਰਕਾਰ ਦਾ ਕਿਹੜਾ ਪੱਧਰ ਜੋੜਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਸੀ?
explainEn: The 73rd Amendment Act of 1992 gave constitutional status to Panchayati Raj institutions, adding the rural local government tier.

qEn: What is the primary motive behind production in multinational corporations (MNCs)?
qHi: ਬਹੁ-ਰਾਸ਼ਟਰੀ ਕੰਪਨੀਆਂ (MNCs) ਵਿੱਚ ਉਤਪਾਦਨ ਦੇ ਪਿੱਛੇ ਮੁੱਖ ਉਦੇਸ਼ ਕੀ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ?
explainEn: Multinational corporations set up production across countries primarily to minimize costs and maximize profits.
